fullPassage: Unfortunately, many people don't take personal responsibility for their own growth. Instead, they simply run the race laid out for them. They do well enough in school to keep advancing. Maybe they manage to get a good job at a well-run company. But so many think and act as if their learning journey ends with college. They have checked all the boxes in the life that was laid out for them and now lack a road map describing the right ways to move forward and continue to grow. In truth, that's when the journey really begins. When school is finished, your growth becomes voluntary. Like healthy eating habits or a regular exercise program, you need to commit to it and devote thought, time, and energy to it. Otherwise, it simply won't happen — and your life and career are likely to stop progressing as a result.

questions.passage: Unfortunately, many people don't take personal responsibility for their own growth. Instead, they simply run the race laid out for them. They do well enough in school to keep advancing. Maybe they manage to get a good job at a well-run company. But so many think and act as if their learning journey ends with college. They have checked all the boxes in the life that was laid out for them and now lack a road map describing the right ways to __________ and continue to grow. In truth, that's when the journey really begins. When school is finished, your growth becomes voluntary. Like healthy eating habits or a regular exercise program, you need to commit to it and devote thought, time, and energy to it. Otherwise, it simply won't happen — and your life and career are likely to stop progressing as a result.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 앞으로 나아가다: 앞으로 나아가고 계속 성장할 올바른 방법이라는 맥락에서 적절
det.analysis:
① move forward(앞으로 나아가다): 'the right ways to ___ and continue to grow'에서 계속 성장한다는 흐름과 연결 ←정답
② give up(포기하다): 성장과 반대
③ stay still(가만히 있다): 성장 흐름과 반대
④ look back(뒤돌아보다): 앞으로 나아간다는 맥락과 어긋남
det.tip: 빈칸 위치: 'the right ways to __________ and continue to grow'

det.korean: 모든 항목을 체크했다: 짜여진 삶에서 요구되는 것을 모두 완수했지만 앞으로의 로드맵은 없다는 맥락
